description: This file defines a Polymer web component behavior, specifically 'PaperInkyFocusBehavior', which implements ripple effects on keyboard focus. It includes HTML imports for dependencies and JavaScript code that declares the behavior implementation and its associated behavior array.

classes.name: Polymer.PaperInkyFocusBehaviorImpl
classes.description: Object implementing the `Polymer.PaperInkyFocusBehavior` with methods to handle focus changes and ripple creation.

methods.name: _focusedChanged
methods.description: Handles focus change events and manages ripple effects based on keyboard focus.

methods.name: _createRipple
methods.description: Creates and configures the ripple element used for visual feedback.
